### vkintox's material 3 fork of ImGui.
this repository holds the ImGui code that VKIntox uses. it has widgets themed around Google's Material 3 and Material You. based on ImGui version v1.92.6. the same code lives under `src/vendor/imgui` in [VKIntox](https://github.com/buwryme/VKIntox), pulled in as a submodule.

`imgui_m3.cc`, `imgui_m3.h` and `imgui_m3_color.h` are the additions; the rest is upstream ImGui with the widget and backend patches VKIntox needs.
